summary: Independent SG-10 review found the real-Agent pilot mostly bounded and fail-closed, but TASK-0040 is not yet approvable because Mode B run 05 artifact lineage is not resolvable by independent Goal inspect with artifact-dir and Mode A does not preserve the invalid real Planner output artifact needed for audit-grade failure evidence.

criteria.criterion: Mode A and Mode B each run at least five bounded repetitions through the generic Goal path.
criteria.notes: Mode A and Mode B each have five bounded repetitions recorded; Mode A fails closed before execution and Mode B uses isolated repetitions.

criteria.criterion: Every Planner output is admitted or rejected before any execution.
criteria.notes: Mode A invalid planner outputs are blocked before GoalExecution start; no execution started from the invalid Planner output.

criteria.criterion: Every Executor side effect has Capability Admission and audit lineage.
criteria.notes: Mode B run 05 has capabilityGrantRefCount=1 and bounded executor evidence, but independent goal inspect with artifact-dir reports missingArtifactCount=3 for ART refs. The report claim of no missing artifact findings is therefore not audit-safe until the artifact lineage is made resolvable or the report explicitly classifies this limitation.

criteria.criterion: false_completion_count, unrun_gate_pass_count, unadmitted_node_execution_count and resume_duplicate_effect_count remain zero.
criteria.notes: Scorecards record zero false completion, zero unrun gate pass, zero stale fencing accept, and zero resume duplicate effect.

criteria.criterion: At least one Mode A run and one Mode B run complete successfully, or the report identifies a reproducible model/adapter blocker without weakening criteria.
criteria.notes: Mode B has one success; Mode A has a reproducible planner/model-adapter blocker without execution bypass.

criteria.criterion: All failures are classified by layer and linked to Artifacts/Evidence.
criteria.notes: Failure classes are summarized, but Mode A run artifacts preserve only planner-blocker.json with the short detail goalId; the invalid real Planner raw output/output artifact is absent, so the blocker is not linked to sufficiently inspectable output evidence.

criteria.criterion: Token, cost, latency, Plan size, repair cycles and verification cost are recorded per run.
criteria.notes: Latency, plan budget/node count, repair cycles, model/tool calls where available, verification cost, and explicit token/cost limitations are recorded per run. Provider tokens are null rather than fabricated.

criteria.criterion: Mode C is skipped automatically after any hard-metric failure in A or B.
criteria.notes: Mode C is skipped and not claimed as completed. The policy also requires at least one successful completion in both Mode A and Mode B; Mode A has none.

criteria.criterion: The final report distinguishes kernel defects from model quality and environment setup failures.
criteria.notes: The report separates planner/model-adapter and executor/model-runtime failures from kernel hard safety metrics.

criteria.criterion: An independent verifier approves the experiment report, not necessarily model quality.
criteria.notes: Independent verifier does not approve this report yet; changes are requested for audit-grade artifact lineage and raw Planner failure evidence.
